SHITET APARTAMENT 3+1 +2 POSTE PARKIMI NE GODINEN ME IKOIKE "TIRANA'S ROCK" E NJOHUR PER FORMEN E SAJ UNIKE TE KOKES SE SKENDERBEUT DHE PER POZICIONIN E PRIVILEGJUAR NE ZEMER TE KRYEQYTETIT. 
GODINA PERBEHET NGA 25 KATE MBI TOKE DHE 5 NENTOKE. ME HYRJE TE DEDIKUAR PER BANIM ME 3 ASHENSORE, ADMINISTRIM KAMERA DHE ROJE SIGURIE 24H.
APARTAMENTI PERBEHET NGA 3 DHOMA GJUMI, SALLON I BOLLSHEM, DY TUALETE SI DHE NJE VERANDE E CILA ESHTE NJE NDER PIKAT E FORTA TE KETIJ APARTAMENTI ME NJE PAMJE PANORAMIKE DIREKTE NGA QENDRA E TIRANES, 
APARTAMENTI KA NJE NDRICIM NATYRAL I ORGANIZUAR NE MENYRE EFIKASE DHE NDODHET NE NJE NGA GODINAT ME TE SIGURTA, MODERNE DHE TE KERKUARA TE TIRANES. 
IDEALE PER BANIM CILESOR APO INVESIM. 
PER CDO INFO NA KONTAKTONI
description_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 3+1 +2 PARKING SPACE IN THE MOST ICONIC BUILDING "TIRANA'S ROCK", KNOWN FOR ITS UNIQUE SHAPE OF SKENDERBEI'S HEAD AND FOR ITS PRIVILEGE POSITION IN THE HEART OF THE CAPITAL. THE BUILDING CONSISTS OF 25 FLOORS ABOVE GROUND AND 5 BELOW GROUND. WITH ENTRANCE DEDICATED FOR RESIDENCE WITH 3 ELEVATORS, ADMINISTRATION CAMERA AND 24H SECURITY GUARD. THE APARTMENT CONSISTS OF 3 BEDROOMS, A SPACIOUS LIVING ROOM, TWO TOILETS AND A VERANDA, WHICH IS ONE OF THE STRENGTHS OF THIS APARTMENT WITH A PANORAMIC VIEW DIRECTLY FROM THE CENTER OF TIRANA, THE APARTMENT HAS AN EFFICIENTLY ORGANIZED NATURAL LIGHT AND IS LOCATED IN ONE OF THE BUILDINGS WITH SAFE, MODERN AND WANTED IN TIRANA.
